notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with deck 18637.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans and Do They Have A Code Clearance?; these count toward the 60.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list uses Do They Have A Code Clearance? (Coruscant set).

Posted Kessel, Coruscant, Tatooine, Hoth, Bespin and Sullust dested the Dark system pages (Coruscant = Special Edition, Tatooine = Premiere, as nothing marks the Episode I printings); 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'Hoth Docking Bay' dested Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark).

Posted 'PS-59' / 'PS-60' dested P-59 / P-60; 'Captain Pelleaon' dested Captain Gilad Pellaeon; 'Commander Merrejek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'We're in Attack Positon' dested We're In Attack Position Now; 'Empire's Back' dested The Empire's Back; 'The Circle in Now Complete' dested The Circle Is Now Complete; 'Imperial Class Star Destroyer' dested Imperial-Class Star Destroyer; 'Vengance', 'Chimaraea', 'Devasator' dested Vengeance, Chimaera, Devastator.
The strategy's update suggests swapping 3 Force Lightning for Darth Vader's Lightsaber, Maul's Lightsaber and Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; the list is kept as posted.
A later, different version by the same author is deck 18637 (Big Blue DONE RIGHT - You're A Slave).
